# design/ (generated, do not edit)

This folder is a copy of [koelony/design](https://github.com/koelony/design) at `e6933b9b8c1d`.
Every file here is overwritten by the next sync, so edits made here are lost.

To change a token, a style or a component, change it in koelony/design. Merging there opens a
PR here titled `design: sync koelony/design@<sha>`. Site-specific styling belongs in the site's
own CSS, after the design/ imports.

- `tokens.css`, `base.css`, `components.css`: plain CSS, imported in that order.
- `cursor.js` (ES module) and `cursor.global.js` (plain script): the Little Koel cursor.
- `lib/`, `react/`: TypeScript and React source for the bundled sites.
- `html/`: the decorative components as plain HTML.
